content_of_post_to_comment: For context i live with my parents and im 22. Growing up this house was never a big comfort place for me. There were constant arguments, parents would yell at me, etc etc. My room was always me hiding. Now, i find myself being drained just by being here. Yes my relationship with my parents has improved slightly (still moments where we dont get along), but everytime i come back home i just sit in my bed and doomscroll. Not even that but sometimes i would just stay in bed for a whole day. I dont have a local coffee shop nearby or just somewhere i can escape. I want to work on my future and goals but i cant even get out of bed. Its like im escaping from my own self and i feel miserable about it. I dont want to keep dwelling on the past and how i was raised. I think about moving out a lot but its really difficult with the expenses and all that, i cant afford it. I dont know what i can do because i dont want to keep living this way. I go to the gym and im in collage, im thinking of finding a part time job as well on the side to keep myself busy but i just dont want to have days on ends where i just scroll on my phone. It doesnt help that I literally dont talk to them, so i would only have to text my friends....
